prs.title: [css-color-4] adjust raytracing algorithm to account for some edge cases
prs.author: romainmenke
prs.body:
Without this adjustment:

_A matrix of colors in `oklch` with `c = 0.2`, `l = 100%` at the top `l = 0%` at the bottom and starting from the left at `h = 0deg`. It shows a pure red cell in a region that should be near black_

After:

_The same matrix, but this time there is no cell with an unexpected value_

----

@facelessuser would be great if you could check this, thanks 🙇

prs.title: [css-color-adjust-1] Fix attribute typo in examples
prs.author: nchevobbe
prs.body:
A few examples were showing a `contents` attribute, when it should be `content`

Fixes #14693
